name: My Loyal Pets
source: Take on the role of a master and explore the depths of pleasure and pain with your gorgeous pets, Britt and Amanda! Test to see which pet is best - doggy or kitty. Which one of them is going to come on top and earn your reward? And just what wicked ideas do the girls have in store for their master once they get what they desire?
translation: 扮演主人的角色，与你华丽的宠物布里特和阿曼达一起探索快乐和痛苦的深处！测试一下哪种宠物最好 - 小狗还是小猫。其中哪一位会脱颖而出并赢得你的奖励？而当她们得到自己想要的东西后，她们又会对主人产生什么邪恶的想法呢？
